scripts.build: npm run prepare:assets && tsc --noEmit && vite build
scripts.android:init: npm run build && npx cap add android && npm run android:configure
scripts.android:configure: npx cap sync android && node scripts/configure-android.mjs
scripts.android:sync: npm run build && npm run android:configure
scripts.android:debug: npm run android:sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.android:release: npm run android:sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease bundleRelease
